institution: Obafemi Awolowo University (OAU), Ile-Ife — Faculty of Technology

courses.title: Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics
courses.description: Fluid properties, hydrostatics, manometry, forces on submerged surfaces, buoyancy & stability, continuity, Bernoulli's equation, pipe flow measurements, and dimensional analysis.

courses.title: Applied Mechanics
courses.description: Forces, moments, couples, static equilibrium, friction, centroids, moments of area, kinematics, Newton's laws, energy and momentum.

courses.title: Engineering Mathematics I
courses.description: Limits, continuity, differentiation, first-order linear ODEs, partial & total derivatives, matrices, determinants, and vector calculus.
